summary: Prove the complete local workflow with redacted disposable evidence
description: Prerequisites: T008-raycast-ux. Run explicit bounded macOS integration checks using one synthetic/disposable Todoist task: selection, deep-link round trip, direct API creation, duplicate invocation, HUD feedback, unchanged Mail state, and cleanup.
acceptance: Redacted evidence proves the Todoist description link opens the exact selected Mail message and Mail state remains unchanged.
A repeated invocation returns the existing task, the HUD messages match typed outcomes, and no credential or correspondence enters Git.
The live proof records macOS, Mail, Raycast, API, cleanup, and residual-risk facts without private identifiers.
